2026-09-18: front hip brackets replaced. The rolls came back a quarter turn round on the hub: captured 1785 / 2113 against the old 2823 / 1098, i.e. -91.2 / +89.2 deg, so the centres are set to the exact hub step (2823-1024 = 1799, 1098+1024 = 2122). The pitch centres captured at the same time (1919 / 2080) differed from the old 2048 by 11.3 / 2.8 deg — not a hub step, so that was the held pose, not the servo; the first walk with them reared and hopped on the front feet. Kept at 2048. Signs watched and unchanged.

2026-09-15: the leg names were MIRRORED left/right — the ids were numbered belly-up, so id 1x is the physical front LEFT, not right. Measured on the floor: vx walked forward but +vy crabbed right and +wz turned right (LiDAR scan match and IMU agree), and the roll levelling diverged. Every entry below was re-keyed by physical servo (old fr_* -> fl_*, old rl_* -> rr_*); centres unchanged per id; the four ROLL signs are flipped as well - the same belly-up session judged 'foot swings left' with left and right reversed. MuJoCo with the gait's output re-wired both ways reproduces the floor (wz +0.3: -41 deg mirrored+roll-inverted against +41 correct; vy +0.05: 7.5 cm right against left), and names-only-fixed predicts the weak right turn the second floor run read (-2.5 sim, -11 measured). UNVERIFIED on the floor since the flip: the pack died. First run: ros2/tools/straight_test.py --wz 0.3, then --vy 0.05; both must read positive.

Measured on the assembled robot, 2026-09-07, dog inverted and unloaded.
centre: all 12 servos were driven to their own middle position (write 128 to TORQUE_ENABLE) while held at the model's mechanical zero, then --capture read the residual. This was necessary, not cosmetic: as assembled, six joints sat within 330 counts of the 0/4095 encoder wrap and could not reach their own soft limits (fr_knee needed +-1128 counts and had 16). Servo.to_counts clamps silently at 0/4095, so capturing there would have baked in joints that stop mid-command with nothing reporting it.
sign: --sign all, then re-verified by commanding all four legs of one axis at once and comparing them against each other. Three of the twelve --sign answers were wrong, all of them roll, all from the same cause -- the prompts are written in the robot's frame and the robot was belly-up, which reverses left and right (and swaps rear-left with rear-right). Pitch and knee were unaffected because their prompts ask about fore/aft, which the flip leaves alone. Verify roll with the robot the right way up, or with a comparison that never names a side.
The pattern is worth knowing before the next assembly: roll splits FRONT/REAR (+1,+1,-1,-1) while pitch and knee split LEFT/RIGHT (+1,-1,+1,-1).
2026-09-13, reassembled in the new case: fl_roll and fr_roll came back at -83/+68 deg of the old centres (fork on another hub tooth); re-captured at the held zero (1098 / 2823, both >1100 counts from the wrap, so no middle-position write) and re-signed, robot upright. The other ten held.
